(* AplCore -- see AplCore.fsi.  Walk interpreter; no operators are exported,
   only functions, because a top-level opr is component-scoped (ledger row 30).
   Values are RR64 throughout: Fortress has no working RR64 -> ZZ32 narrowing
   (ledger: narrow on the floor bracket's ZZ64 cannot be found), so integer
   display is done by stringifying the floor bracket itself -- see aplFmt. *)
component AplCore

import List.{...}
export AplCore

(* ------------------------------------------------------------- carrier *)
value object AplArr(shape: List[\ZZ32\], data: List[\RR64\])
    getter rank(): ZZ32 = |self.shape|
    getter asString(): String = aplShow(self)
end

aplOrigin(): ZZ32 = 0

(* ------------------------------------------------------------- numbers *)
(* |\ v /| is the library's floor bracket; it yields a ZZ64, which stringifies
   as an integer even though it will not narrow to a ZZ32. *)
aplFloor1(v: RR64): RR64 = 1.0 (|\ v /|)
aplCeil1(v: RR64): RR64 = 1.0 (|/ v \|)

(* A negative number prints with APL's high minus ¯ (U+00AF), not the
   hyphen: the book's v[3] ← ¯1 prints back as ¯1.  String literals have no \u
   escape (Literal.rats:182-195), so the character stands in the source, which
   is read as UTF-8. *)
aplFmt(v: RR64): String =
    if v < 0.0 then ("¯" aplFmt(-v))
    elif (1.0 (|\ v /|)) = v then ("" (|\ v /|))
    else ("" v) end

(* RR64 -> ZZ32 by doubling and halving, since narrow is unavailable. *)
aplAsInt(v: RR64): ZZ32 = do
    k: ZZ32 := 0
    step: ZZ32 := 1
    if v > 0.0 then
        while (1.0 (k + step)) <= v do
            k := k + step
            step := step 2
        end
        while step > 1 do
            step := step DIV 2
            if (1.0 (k + step)) <= v then k := k + step end
        end
    end
    k
  end

aplWidth(s: String): ZZ32 = |s|

aplPad(s: String, w: ZZ32): String = do
    r: String := s
    while (aplWidth(r)) < w do r := (" " r) end
    r
  end

aplCell(x: AplArr, i: ZZ32): String = aplFmt(x.data[i])

(* ------------------------------------------------------------- display *)
aplShow(x: AplArr): String = do
    r = |x.shape|
    if r = 0 then aplFmt(x.data[0])
    elif r = 1 then
        if (|x.data|) = 0 then ""
        else (BIG |||[ v <- seq(x.data) ] aplFmt(v))
        end
    else
        cols = x.shape[r - 1]
        rows = (|x.data|) DIV cols
        if (cols = 0) OR (rows = 0) then ""
        else
            ws: List[\ZZ32\] =
                <|[\ZZ32\] (BIG MAX[ i <- seq(0 # rows) ]
                              aplWidth(aplCell(x, (i cols) + k)))
                  | k <- seq(0 # cols) |>
            (BIG //[ i <- seq(0 # rows) ]
                (BIG |||[ k <- seq(0 # cols) ]
                    aplPad(aplCell(x, (i cols) + k), ws[k])))
        end
    end
  end

(* ------------------------------------------------------- constructors *)
aplScalar(v: RR64): AplArr = AplArr(<|[\ZZ32\] |>, <|[\RR64\] v |>)
aplZilde(): AplArr = AplArr(<|[\ZZ32\] 0 |>, <|[\RR64\] |>)
aplVec(d: List[\RR64\]): AplArr = AplArr(<|[\ZZ32\] |d| |>, d)

aplCountOf(sh: List[\ZZ32\]): ZZ32 = (PROD[ i <- seq(0 # |sh|) ] sh[i])

(* ---------------------------------------------------------- primitives *)
aplIota(a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    n = aplAsInt(a.data[0])
    o = aplOrigin()
    aplVec(<|[\RR64\] 1.0 (i + o) | i <- seq(0 # n) |>)
  end

aplShapeOf(a: AplArr): AplArr = aplVec(<|[\RR64\] 1.0 s | s <- seq(a.shape) |>)

aplReshape(s: AplArr, a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    sh: List[\ZZ32\] = <|[\ZZ32\] aplAsInt(v) | v <- seq(s.data) |>
    n = aplCountOf(sh)
    m = |a.data|
    AplArr(sh, <|[\RR64\] a.data[i MOD m] | i <- seq(0 # n) |>)
  end

aplTally(a: AplArr): AplArr =
    if (|a.shape|) = 0 then aplScalar(1.0) else aplScalar(1.0 (a.shape[0])) end

aplFirst(a: AplArr): AplArr = aplScalar(a.data[0])

aplRavel(a: AplArr): AplArr = aplVec(a.data)

aplCat(a: AplArr, b: AplArr): AplArr = aplVec(a.data || b.data)

aplSame(a: AplArr, b: AplArr): Boolean = do
    ok: Boolean := ((|a.shape|) = (|b.shape|)) AND ((|a.data|) = (|b.data|))
    if ok then
        i: ZZ32 := 0
        while i < (|a.shape|) do
            if (a.shape[i]) =/= (b.shape[i]) then ok := false end
            i := i + 1
        end
        j: ZZ32 := 0
        while j < (|a.data|) do
            if (a.data[j]) =/= (b.data[j]) then ok := false end
            j := j + 1
        end
    end
    ok
  end

aplMatch(a: AplArr, b: AplArr): AplArr =
    if aplSame(a, b) then aplScalar(1.0) else aplScalar(0.0) end

aplReverse(a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    r = |a.shape|
    if r = 0 then a
    elif r = 1 then
        do
            n = |a.data|
            AplArr(a.shape, <|[\RR64\] a.data[(n - 1) - i] | i <- seq(0 # n) |>)
        end
    else
        do
            cols = a.shape[r - 1]
            rows = (|a.data|) DIV cols
            AplArr(a.shape,
                   <|[\RR64\] a.data[(i cols) + ((cols - 1) - k)]
                     | i <- seq(0 # rows), k <- seq(0 # cols) |>)
        end
    end
  end

aplReverseFirst(a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    r = |a.shape|
    if r <= 1 then aplReverse(a)
    else
        do
            cols = a.shape[r - 1]
            rows = (|a.data|) DIV cols
            AplArr(a.shape,
                   <|[\RR64\] a.data[(((rows - 1) - i) cols) + k]
                     | i <- seq(0 # rows), k <- seq(0 # cols) |>)
        end
    end
  end

aplTranspose(a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    r = |a.shape|
    if r <= 1 then a
    else
        do
            rows = a.shape[0]
            cols = a.shape[1]
            AplArr(<|[\ZZ32\] cols, rows |>,
                   <|[\RR64\] a.data[(q cols) + p]
                     | p <- seq(0 # cols), q <- seq(0 # rows) |>)
        end
    end
  end

aplNegate(a: AplArr): AplArr =
    AplArr(a.shape, <|[\RR64\] -v | v <- seq(a.data) |>)

aplMap(f: RR64 -> RR64, a: AplArr): AplArr =
    AplArr(a.shape, <|[\RR64\] f(v) | v <- seq(a.data) |>)

(* -------------------------------------- elementwise, scalar extension *)
aplZip(f: (RR64, RR64) -> RR64, a: AplArr, b: AplArr): AplArr =
    if ((|a.data|) = 1) AND ((|b.data|) =/= 1) then
        AplArr(b.shape, <|[\RR64\] f(a.data[0], v) | v <- seq(b.data) |>)
    elif ((|b.data|) = 1) AND ((|a.data|) =/= 1) then
        AplArr(a.shape, <|[\RR64\] f(v, b.data[0]) | v <- seq(a.data) |>)
    else
        AplArr(a.shape,
               <|[\RR64\] f(a.data[i], b.data[i]) | i <- seq(0 # |a.data|) |>)
    end

aplBool(b: Boolean): RR64 = if b then 1.0 else 0.0 end

(* ------------------------------------------------------- dispatch by name *)
aplDy(f: String, a: AplArr, b: AplArr): AplArr =
    if f = "plus" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => p + q, a, b)
    elif f = "minus" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => p - q, a, b)
    elif f = "times" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => p q, a, b)
    elif f = "divide" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => p / q, a, b)
    elif f = "power" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => p^q, a, b)
    elif f = "ceil" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => p MAX q, a, b)
    elif f = "floor" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => p MIN q, a, b)
    elif f = "eq" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => aplBool(p = q), a, b)
    elif f = "ne" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => aplBool(p =/= q), a, b)
    elif f = "lt" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => aplBool(p < q), a, b)
    elif f = "le" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => aplBool(p <= q), a, b)
    elif f = "gt" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => aplBool(p > q), a, b)
    elif f = "ge" then aplZip(fn (p: RR64, q: RR64): RR64 => aplBool(p >= q), a, b)
    elif f = "rho" then aplReshape(a, b)
    elif f = "cat" then aplCat(a, b)
    elif f = "match" then aplMatch(a, b)
    elif f = "squad" then aplSquad(a, b)
    else aplScalar(-999.0) end

aplMon(f: String, a: AplArr): AplArr =
    if f = "iota" then aplIota(a)
    elif f = "rho" then aplShapeOf(a)
    elif f = "tally" then aplTally(a)
    elif f = "first" then aplFirst(a)
    elif f = "reverse" then aplReverse(a)
    elif f = "reversefirst" then aplReverseFirst(a)
    elif f = "transpose" then aplTranspose(a)
    elif f = "cat" then aplRavel(a)
    elif f = "minus" then aplNegate(a)
    elif f = "plus" then a
    elif f = "ceil" then aplMap(fn (v: RR64): RR64 => aplCeil1(v), a)
    elif f = "floor" then aplMap(fn (v: RR64): RR64 => aplFloor1(v), a)
    elif f = "times" then aplMap(fn (v: RR64): RR64 =>
                                   if v > 0.0 then 1.0
                                   elif v < 0.0 then -1.0
                                   else 0.0 end, a)
    elif f = "divide" then aplMap(fn (v: RR64): RR64 => 1.0 / v, a)
    elif f = "where" then aplWhere(a)
    else aplScalar(-999.0) end

(* A reduction folds right to left, as APL's does. *)
aplFoldData(f: String, a: AplArr, start: ZZ32, stride: ZZ32, n: ZZ32): RR64 = do
    if n = 0 then 0.0
    else
        acc: RR64 := a.data[start + ((n - 1) stride)]
        j: ZZ32 := n - 2
        while j >= 0 do
            acc := (aplDy(f, aplScalar(a.data[start + (j stride)]),
                             aplScalar(acc))).data[0]
            j := j - 1
        end
        acc
    end
  end

aplRed(f: String, axis: String, a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    r = |a.shape|
    if r = 0 then a
    elif r = 1 then aplScalar(aplFoldData(f, a, 0, 1, |a.data|))
    else
        do
            cols = a.shape[r - 1]
            rows = (|a.data|) DIV cols
            if f = "nofn" then a
            elif axis = "first" then
                aplVec(<|[\RR64\] aplFoldData(f, a, k, cols, rows)
                         | k <- seq(0 # cols) |>)
            else
                aplVec(<|[\RR64\] aplFoldData(f, a, i cols, 1, cols)
                         | i <- seq(0 # rows) |>)
            end
        end
    end
  end

(* ================================================ rung 2: indexing ======= *)

aplRankOf(a: AplArr): ZZ32 = |a.shape|
aplColsOf(a: AplArr): ZZ32 = a.shape[(|a.shape|) - 1]
aplRowsOf(a: AplArr): ZZ32 = a.shape[0]

aplAxisIx(n: ZZ32): AplArr = aplVec(<|[\RR64\] 1.0 k | k <- seq(0 # n) |>)

(* The shape of an indexed result is the shapes of the index expressions
   concatenated: a scalar index contributes nothing, so m[1;1] is a scalar,
   m[1;] a vector, and v[5 2] a vector. *)
aplIx1(a: AplArr, i: AplArr): AplArr =
    AplArr(i.shape, <|[\RR64\] a.data[aplAsInt(p)] | p <- seq(i.data) |>)

aplIx2(a: AplArr, i: AplArr, j: AplArr): AplArr = do
    cols = aplColsOf(a)
    AplArr(i.shape || j.shape,
           <|[\RR64\] a.data[(aplAsInt(p) cols) + aplAsInt(q)]
             | p <- seq(i.data), q <- seq(j.data) |>)
  end

aplIxRow(a: AplArr, i: AplArr): AplArr = aplIx2(a, i, aplAxisIx(aplColsOf(a)))
aplIxCol(a: AplArr, j: AplArr): AplArr = aplIx2(a, aplAxisIx(aplRowsOf(a)), j)

(* ---------------------------------------------- indexed assignment ------- *)
(* AplArr is a value object, so an indexed assignment builds an updated copy;
   the grammar stores it back into the workspace.  idx is the list of flat
   positions being assigned, in the order the values are consumed. *)
aplPut1(old: RR64, k: ZZ32, idx: List[\ZZ32\], v: AplArr): RR64 = do
    res: RR64 := old
    t: ZZ32 := 0
    while t < (|idx|) do
        if (idx[t]) = k then
            res := if (|v.data|) = 1 then v.data[0] else v.data[t] end
        end
        t := t + 1
    end
    res
  end

aplPutAt(a: AplArr, idx: List[\ZZ32\], v: AplArr): AplArr =
    AplArr(a.shape,
           <|[\RR64\] aplPut1(a.data[k], k, idx, v) | k <- seq(0 # |a.data|) |>)

aplIxSet1(a: AplArr, i: AplArr, v: AplArr): AplArr =
    aplPutAt(a, <|[\ZZ32\] aplAsInt(p) | p <- seq(i.data) |>, v)

aplIxSet2(a: AplArr, i: AplArr, j: AplArr, v: AplArr): AplArr = do
    cols = aplColsOf(a)
    aplPutAt(a, <|[\ZZ32\] (aplAsInt(p) cols) + aplAsInt(q)
                  | p <- seq(i.data), q <- seq(j.data) |>, v)
  end

aplIxSetRow(a: AplArr, i: AplArr, v: AplArr): AplArr =
    aplIxSet2(a, i, aplAxisIx(aplColsOf(a)), v)
aplIxSetCol(a: AplArr, j: AplArr, v: AplArr): AplArr =
    aplIxSet2(a, aplAxisIx(aplRowsOf(a)), j, v)

(* Selective assignment.  APL inverts an arbitrary expression on the left of ←;
   here each invertible form is its own function, called from its own
   production: the compress form and the main-diagonal transpose. *)
aplSelSet(a: AplArr, sel: AplArr, v: AplArr): AplArr = do
    idx: List[\ZZ32\] := <|[\ZZ32\] |>
    k: ZZ32 := 0
    while k < (|a.data|) do
        m = if (|sel.data|) = 1 then sel.data[0] else sel.data[k] end
        if m =/= 0.0 then idx := idx || <|[\ZZ32\] k |> end
        k := k + 1
    end
    aplPutAt(a, idx, v)
  end

aplDiagSet(a: AplArr, v: AplArr): AplArr = do
    cols = aplColsOf(a)
    n = aplRowsOf(a) MIN cols
    aplPutAt(a, <|[\ZZ32\] (k cols) + k | k <- seq(0 # n) |>, v)
  end

(* ------------------------------------------------------ scatter indexing - *)
(* A coordinate vector, one index per axis, addresses one cell; several of them
   are collected into a k-by-rank matrix, so a list of index vectors needs no
   element type that can hold an array. *)
aplOffsetAt(a: AplArr, c: List[\RR64\], base: ZZ32): ZZ32 = do
    off: ZZ32 := 0
    k: ZZ32 := 0
    while k < (|a.shape|) do
        off := (off (a.shape[k])) + aplAsInt(c[base + k])
        k := k + 1
    end
    off
  end

aplPick(a: AplArr, c: AplArr): AplArr = aplScalar(a.data[aplOffsetAt(a, c.data, 0)])

aplIdxOne(v: AplArr): AplArr = AplArr(<|[\ZZ32\] 1, |v.data| |>, v.data)

aplIdxCons(v: AplArr, rest: AplArr): AplArr =
    AplArr(<|[\ZZ32\] (rest.shape[0]) + 1, rest.shape[1] |>, v.data || rest.data)

aplScatter(a: AplArr, cs: AplArr): AplArr = do
    r = cs.shape[1]
    aplVec(<|[\RR64\] a.data[aplOffsetAt(a, cs.data, t r)]
             | t <- seq(0 # cs.shape[0]) |>)
  end

(* --------------------------------------------------------------- squad ⌷ - *)
aplSquad(i: AplArr, a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    r = aplRankOf(a)
    n = |i.data|
    if r <= 1 then aplScalar(a.data[aplAsInt(i.data[0])])
    elif n >= r then aplPick(a, i)
    else aplIxRow(a, aplScalar(i.data[0]))
    end
  end

aplSquadEncl(i: AplArr, a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    r = aplRankOf(a)
    if r <= 1 then aplIx1(a, i)
    else aplIx2(a, i, aplAxisIx(aplColsOf(a)))
    end
  end

(* ------------------------------------------------------------- ⍸ Where --- *)
aplWhere(a: AplArr): AplArr = do
    out: List[\RR64\] := <|[\RR64\] |>
    k: ZZ32 := 0
    while k < (|a.data|) do
        if (a.data[k]) =/= 0.0 then out := out || <|[\RR64\] 1.0 k |> end
        k := k + 1
    end
    aplVec(out)
  end

(* --------------------------------------------- compress and replicate ---- *)
aplRepList(sel: AplArr, d: List[\RR64\]): List[\RR64\] = do
    out: List[\RR64\] := <|[\RR64\] |>
    i: ZZ32 := 0
    while i < (|d|) do
        c = aplAsInt(if (|sel.data|) = 1 then sel.data[0] else sel.data[i] end)
        t: ZZ32 := 0
        while t < c do
            out := out || <|[\RR64\] d[i] |>
            t := t + 1
        end
        i := i + 1
    end
    out
  end

aplSelIx(sel: AplArr, n: ZZ32): AplArr =
    aplVec(aplRepList(sel, <|[\RR64\] 1.0 k | k <- seq(0 # n) |>))

aplCompress(sel: AplArr, a: AplArr): AplArr =
    if aplRankOf(a) <= 1 then aplVec(aplRepList(sel, a.data))
    else aplIx2(a, aplAxisIx(aplRowsOf(a)), aplSelIx(sel, aplColsOf(a)))
    end

aplCompressFirst(sel: AplArr, a: AplArr): AplArr =
    if aplRankOf(a) <= 1 then aplVec(aplRepList(sel, a.data))
    else aplIx2(a, aplSelIx(sel, aplRowsOf(a)), aplAxisIx(aplColsOf(a)))
    end

aplScalarNeg(v: RR64): AplArr = aplScalar(-v)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------- workspace --- *)
(* APL's own variables.  A template cannot expand to a Fortress binding or an
   assignment (gap row 8), but it can expand to a call, so the sub-language's
   names live in one mutable object held by this component. *)
object AplWs()
    var names: List[\String\] := <|[\String\] |>
    var vals: List[\AplArr\] := <|[\AplArr\] |>

    find(n: String): ZZ32 = do
        k: ZZ32 := -1
        i: ZZ32 := 0
        while i < (|names|) do
            if (names[i]) = n then k := i end
            i := i + 1
        end
        k
      end

    put(n: String, v: AplArr): () = do
        k = find(n)
        if k < 0 then
            names := names || <|[\String\] n |>
            vals := vals || <|[\AplArr\] v |>
        else
            vals := <|[\AplArr\] if i = k then v else vals[i] end
                      | i <- seq(0 # |vals|) |>
        end
      end

    get(n: String): AplArr = do
        k = find(n)
        if k < 0 then aplZilde() else vals[k] end
      end

    clear(): () = do
        names := <|[\String\] |>
        vals := <|[\AplArr\] |>
      end
end

aplWs: AplWs = AplWs()

aplSet(n: String, v: AplArr): AplArr = do aplWs.put(n, v); v end
aplGet(n: String): AplArr = aplWs.get(n)
aplWsClear(): () = aplWs.clear()

end

component p14_genwrap
import List.{...}
export Executable

object V(var data: RR64) getter asString(): String = "V(" data ")" end

(* A carrier that is BOTH a distinct excluding type (so Mat.Vec and Vec.Mat
   can both be declared) AND a library generator/indexed value (so |x|, x[i]
   and  <| e | u <- x |>  all work with no hand-written glue and no field
   noise in renders). *)
trait Rank1V excludes Rank2V end
trait Rank2V excludes Rank1V end

object Vec(xs: List[\V\]) extends { Rank1V, ZeroIndexed[\V\], DelegatedIndexed[\V,ZZ32\] }
  getter asString(): String = "" xs
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0#|xs|
  opr |self| : ZZ32 = |xs|
  opr [i: ZZ32]: V = xs[i]
  opr [r: Range[\ZZ32\]]: ZeroIndexed[\V\] = Vec(xs[r])
end

object Mat(rows: List[\Vec\]) extends { Rank2V, ZeroIndexed[\Vec\], DelegatedIndexed[\Vec,ZZ32\] }
  getter asString(): String = "" rows
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0#|rows|
  opr |self| : ZZ32 = |rows|
  opr [i: ZZ32]: Vec = rows[i]
  opr [r: Range[\ZZ32\]]: ZeroIndexed[\Vec\] = Mat(rows[r])
end

opr DOT(u: Vec, w: Vec): V = V(SUM[m <- seq(0#|u|)] (u[m].data w[m].data))
opr juxtaposition(m: Mat, x: Vec): Vec = Vec(<|[\V\] (r DOT x) | r <- m |>)
opr juxtaposition(p: Vec, m: Mat): Vec =
  Vec(<|[\V\] (V(SUM[j <- seq(0#|p|)] (p[j].data (m[j])[c].data))) | c <- 0#|m[0]| |>)

run() = do
  x = Vec(<|[\V\] V(1.0), V(2.0)|>)
  m = Mat(<|[\Vec\] Vec(<|[\V\] V(1.0), V(0.0)|>), Vec(<|[\V\] V(0.0), V(3.0)|>)|>)
  println("m x  = " (m x))
  println("x m  = " (x m))
  println("|x|  = " |x| "   x[1] = " x[1])
  println("comprehension over Vec: " <|[\RR64\] (u.data) | u <- x|>)
  println("for over Mat: ")
  for r <- seq(m) do println("  row " r) end
end
end
